claims.claim_text: Firefly Aerospace 讓 NVIDIA Jetson 這顆邊緣運算晶片，隨著 Ocula 月球影像衛星服務首度在月球軌道上執行推論——直接在衛星上跑模型，而不是把原始影像整包下傳回地球再處理。
claims.evidence: marking the first time the NVIDIA Jetson edge AI platform has operated in lunar orbit... rather than sending massive volumes of raw data home for processing that takes weeks or months, Ocula will run AI algorithms directly on orbit...transmit only the most relevant information...back to Earth in near real time.

claims.claim_text: 這篇文章把低延遲交易系統會用到的技巧串成一條線——kernel bypass、CPU 頻率與 PCIe ASPM 調校、hugepages、isolcpus／nohz_full／rcu_nocbs、cache 對齊，還有 lock-free 的 SPSC queue。作者的核心論點是：P99 尾延遲通常不是敗在少用了幾條 AVX 指令，而是敗在作業系統與硬體設定沒調對。
claims.evidence: DPDK polling mode is one of the best approaches...Disable C-states and Turbo Boost...Lock PCIe ASPM off...Enable hugepages...Use isolcpus, nohz_full, and rcu_nocbs kernel parameters...Prefetch and cache-align structs...Use lock-free SPSC queues. Addressing these latency sources requires a set of engineering decisions baked into the application design itself, not patched in afterwards.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 宣布在出口管制解除後，恢復 Claude Fable 5 與 Mythos 5 的存取——這兩個模型先前因為一起被回報的越獄事件而暫時下架。公告內容包含新增的防護機制，以及一套判斷越獄嚴重程度的產業框架提案。
claims.evidence: The export control directive on June 12 came after the government became aware of a report in which Amazon researchers had found a method of bypassing Fable 5's safeguards...we trained an improved safety classifier that targets and blocks the behavior described in the report...Capability gain...Breadth of capability gain...Ease of weaponization...Discoverability.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 發表 Claude Fable 5 與 Claude Mythos 5：Fable 5 是附帶防護機制的一般用途版本，Mythos 5 則是開放給經授權資安與研究夥伴、限制較少的版本。兩者在程式撰寫、知識工作、視覺與科學任務上都達到業界頂尖水準。
claims.evidence: Today we're launching Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we've made safe for general use...the same underlying model as Fable 5, but with the safeguards lifted in some areas...scores highest among frontier models...Fable 5 has the highest score of any model...Fable 5 is the new state-of-the-art model for tasks involving vision...consistently produce novel, compelling scientific hypotheses.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 推出 Claude Science，把原本分散的研究工具整合進一個工作台，提供可重現的產出、算力管理，以及橫跨基因體學、蛋白質體學與結構生物學等領域、預先設定好的 60 多個科學資料庫存取介面。
claims.evidence: Claude Science brings these fragmented tools into a single research environment where scientists can conduct all stages of their work. Every output carries an auditable history of how it was made, so you can validate and reproduce the results. Claude Science handles this process for you...scaling the analysis from a single GPU to hundreds as needed...over 60 curated skills and connectors pre-configured for genomics, single-cell, proteomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and more...connects to more than 60 scientific databases.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 的 Frontier Red Team 拆解了 Claude Opus 4.6 針對一個 Firefox 漏洞寫出的、真的能動的瀏覽器漏洞利用程式。團隊逐步分析模型如何把任務拆成位址洩漏、任意讀寫這些經典的漏洞利用元件。
claims.evidence: Claude Opus 4.6 developed the exploit. The vulnerability is CVE-2026-2796, a JIT miscompilation in Firefox's JavaScript WebAssembly component...'This allows reading wrong fields → info leak. 3. With info leak, I can build arbitrary read/write.'...'I'll use the UAF to build an addrof/fakeobj primitive using WebAssembly'...Opus 4.6 is the first model we have observed writing a successful browser exploit with minimal hand holding.

claims.claim_text: Zig 的開發日誌記錄了一項架構調整：套件管理相關的功能，全部從編譯器裡搬到了建置系統。這個決定把「編譯程式碼」與「管理相依套件」這兩件事徹底切開，理由是關注點分離。
claims.evidence: Now that there is a separate process for users' build.zig scripts and the build system itself, it makes sense for that to be the place that package management logic lives...I moved these subcommands to the maker process: zig build, zig fetch, zig init, zig libc.
claims.note: Core fact (package management relocated from compiler to build-system/maker process) is directly supported. The post's framing 理由是關注點分離 (separation of concerns) is the author's gloss — the devlog's literal stated rationale is process-architecture-driven, not a named principle. Reasonable interpretive characterization of a real architectural split, left verified; flagged for awareness only.

claims.claim_text: Google 開源了一套用零知識證明（ZKP）做年齡驗證的協定，讓服務可以確認使用者年齡，卻不需要因此得知其餘身分資訊。這對愈來愈多要求年齡驗證的法規環境，提供了一條不用把個資整包交出去的技術路徑，協定開放使用也代表其他平台不必各自重新設計一套。
claims.evidence: a person visiting a website can verifiably prove he or she is over 18, without sharing anything else at all...Today, we open sourced our Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) libraries...developers are invited to freely use the ZKP codebase to build privacy-focused applications...the EU's eIDAS Regulation...encourages Member States to integrate privacy-enhancing technologies like ZKP.
